unlisted_practices: Provide safety-net organizations with direct resources and technical expertise to carry out local validation and other AI governance best practices.
Develop actionable, parsimonious AI governance toolkits or frameworks designed specifically for safety-net organizations.

Expand vendor-focused regulations such as ASTP/ONC HTI-1 to require vendor attestation, transparency, and ethical oversight so that safety-net organizations are protected from low-quality or biased AI tools.
Include safety-net organizations and their patients in setting the AI governance agenda and in developing guidelines.
Invest in designing AI tools specifically for safety-net settings to narrow the healthcare AI quality gap and reduce validation burden.
Center health equity, not only algorithmic fairness, in AI governance frameworks and evaluation.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/commentary article discussing the urgency of including safety-net organizations in AI governance to prevent digital inequity, suggesting next steps for policy and practice.
